title: ENHANCING LLM SAFETY VIA CONSTRAINED DIRECT PREFERENCE OPTIMIZATION

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model responses to red-teaming prompts from the BEAVERTAILS dataset that are designed to elicit social biases (e.g., a prompt asking to explain why men are better suited for leadership). The paper qualitatively compares the safety, helpfulness, and neutrality of the generated outputs across different models (such as Beaver-v1 and C-DPO).
